boundary_argument: For circle distance d and a common boundary heading h, |d(h,u)-d(h,v)| <= d(u,v). Apply at both ends of each moving path and sum. This is a direction-sequence bound, not a vehicle dynamics guarantee.
displacement_screen_limit: Only a necessary v2 axis-displacement condition at a hypothetical 1 m/cell scale; no map scale is selected, no automatic scaling or v2 extension. Primitive lengths/speeds, absolute coordinates, body clearance, synchronous actual inputs, shared task initial pose and zero wait drift remain unchecked.

rows.interpretation: Geometry only. Interval allows arbitrary common initial/final headings and shortest heading changes while facing each edge. Reverse driving, smooth dynamics, overlapping turn/wait and multi-robot retiming are not evaluated.

after.assumption: Every moving grid edge is one original v2 MOVE, all with one common scale. This tests only the 0.25 m minimum MOVE and 8 m task-relative axis bound.
